title: Not a President
shared_visual_asset: Two-panel card: 'NOT A PRESIDENT' (Franklin) / 'ALSO NOT A PRESIDENT' (Hamilton) — the founder's own existing asset.
merge_rationale: Confusability — people commonly assume any prominent Founding-era figure was a President. Notably, this fact also belongs to each person's entity hub simultaneously, confirming a Fact can carry both a structural cluster_id and an entity_tag at once — the two clustering mechanisms aren't mutually exclusive.
